name: io.github.sayod111/sayod111-radar
title: SAYOD 111 Intelligence Radar
description: 8-radar B2B API: Shopify, Cyber/DMARC, SEC RIAs/Form D, Biotech/FDA, Recompetes, FMCSA, EU/UK.

tools.name: audit_domain_tristate
tools.description: Audit a business domain for Shopify/Klaviyo retention gaps, SaaS Trust Centers, or DNS DMARC posture with Tri-State Null Integrity.

tools.name: search_sec_ria_firms
tools.description: Search indexed U.S. SEC Form ADV Registered Investment Advisors by firm prefix, state, or disclosure flag.

tools.name: search_biotech_fda_signals
tools.description: Search NIH RePORTER grants, active industry ClinicalTrials.gov v2 sponsors, and openFDA 510(k)/recalls.

tools.name: list_sec_form_d_startups
tools.description: List daily U.S. SEC EDGAR Form D operating startup funding filings (funds/SPVs filtered out, zero personal addresses).

tools.name: list_federal_recompetes
tools.description: List expiring U.S. federal contracts ($500K+) in the next 6-18 months by NAICS code or state.

tools.name: list_fmcsa_freight_carriers
tools.description: List newly authorized U.S. DOT FMCSA commercial interstate freight carriers (zero consumer PII).

tools.name: list_eu_uk_public_tenders
tools.description: List recent EU TED v3 and UK Find a Tender public procurement notices (OGL v3.0 / EU 2023/138).

tools.name: get_radar_health_stats
tools.description: Return live Cloudflare Edge D1 record counts across all 8 Sayod 111 B2B signal radars.
